component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
' Both observers are registered here, in init(), so the port lives in the task's m. sub init() m.top.functionName = "idle" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("cmd", m.port) m.top.observeField("cmd", "onCmd") print "PORT in init: type=" + type(m.port) m.calls = 0 m.got = 0 end sub
' Function observer: runs on the writer (render) thread, which reads the same m.port. sub onCmd() m.calls++ if m.calls = 1 then print "PORT on render: type=" + type(m.port) + " ifMessagePort=" + (GetInterface(m.port, "ifMessagePort") <> invalid).toStr() if GetInterface(m.port, "ifMessagePort") = invalid then return msg = m.port.getMessage() if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" then m.got++ if m.calls = 10 m.top.report = "render onCmd calls=" + m.calls.toStr() + " port messages=" + m.got.toStr() end if end sub
' The task never drains m.port, so the render-side getMessage() is the only reader. sub idle() m.top.ready = true sleep(3000) end sub
